properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 24 at 4:12AM EDT until October 24 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Lakeshore MI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...Lakeshore County.

* WHEN...From noon today to 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree limbs could be blown down.
properties.instruction: Secure outdoor objects such as canopies and tents. Use extra caution when driving, especially if operating a high profile vehicle.

NWSheadline: WIND ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM NOON TODAY TO 8 PM EDT THIS EVENING
